events.message: a client connects to the voice agent over WebSocket
the server sent a welcome message
the server opens with a welcome message that carries protocol version 1
start_call brought the status to listening
start_call is answered with an audio_config message, mp3 by default

parts.text: You are a voice assistant. Keep answers to one or two sentences.
what is the weather in Paris
It is 21 degrees and sunny in Paris.

events.message: turn 1 ended with a turn_metrics message
an interim transcript arrives, with the text the fake transcriber gave
a final transcript arrives for the user, with the utterance's text
the interim transcript comes before the final one
the transcriber received exactly the one audio frame the client sent
the tool ran inside the turn, after onTurn started and before the reply was synthesized: onTurn:what is the weather in Paris | tool:Paris | tts:It is 21 degrees and sunny in Paris.
the model's second step in the same turn saw the tool result
one audio frame followed the reply
the audio frame holds the fake TTS provider's bytes
turn_metrics reports a completed turn that began as speech, with a total duration
turn_metrics holds the final-input-to-first-audio latency, which a sent audio frame makes measurable
the signal onTurn received stayed live while the turn completed
the status returned to listening after the reply

parts.text: It is 21 degrees and sunny in Paris.
Tomorrow looks dry across the region. Rain is due on Friday.

events.message: turn 2 reached the speaking status
the TTS call for the held sentence started
the first sentence of turn 2 reached the client as audio while it was speaking
before the interrupt, no turn signal is aborted and onInterrupt has not run
the interrupt brought a new listening status
the interrupted turn ended with its own turn_metrics message
the interrupt aborted turn 2's context.signal and left turn 1's alone
the TTS call that was speaking saw the same abort
the signal passed to streamText reached the model call: aborted for turn 2, live for turn 1
onInterrupt ran once
the status returned to listening after the interrupt
the interrupted turn closed with a turn_metrics outcome of aborted
turn 2's model request holds no tool message from turn 1
and no tool result
